evidence.title: Giga-Scale AI and the Ethernet Evolution: How Spectrum-X Ethernet Rewrites the Rules

summary: A new Ethernet protocol dubbed Spectrum‑X dramatically boosts bandwidth and lowers latency, allowing AI models to scale to gigabyte‑level data streams without bottlenecks. The technology is poised to reshape data‑center networking and accelerate next‑generation AI workloads.
title: Spectrum-X Ethernet Enables Giga-Scale AI Computing
